# Raw and dotenv values are injected from verified ciphertext without revealing
# either selected file. Arguments are passed literally and the inherited
# environment is preserved.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin

cp raw-fixture raw.txt
cp env-fixture vars.env
exec sesam add raw.txt vars.env
rm raw.txt vars.env

env INHERITED=kept
exec sesam run --secret raw.txt --env-file vars.env -- runprobe env INHERITED SESAM_SECRET_RAW_TXT TOKEN EMPTY LITERAL
stdout 'INHERITED="kept" exists=true'
stdout 'SESAM_SECRET_RAW_TXT="raw-value\\n" exists=true'
stdout 'TOKEN="dotenv value" exists=true'
stdout 'EMPTY="" exists=true'
stdout 'LITERAL="\$\(touch_owned\)" exists=true'
! exists raw.txt
! exists vars.env
! exists touch_owned

exec sesam run --secret raw.txt -- runprobe args 'hello world' ';touch-owned' '$HOME'
stdout '0="hello world"'
stdout '1=";touch-owned"'
stdout '2="\$HOME"'
! exists touch-owned

# --all exports every accessible secret as raw values, except explicit
# --env-file paths which are parsed instead.
exec sesam run --all --env-file vars.env -- runprobe env SESAM_SECRET_RAW_TXT TOKEN SESAM_SECRET_VARS_ENV
stdout 'SESAM_SECRET_RAW_TXT="raw-value\\n" exists=true'
stdout 'TOKEN="dotenv value" exists=true'
stdout 'SESAM_SECRET_VARS_ENV="" exists=false'

# The repository lock is closed before exec, so the replacement can invoke
# sesam against the same repository.
exec sesam run --secret raw.txt -- runprobe reenter
stdout '^admin$'

# Cwd-relative selectors become canonical sesam-relative paths before repo use.
mkdir sub
cp raw-fixture sub/nested.txt
exec sesam add sub/nested.txt
rm sub/nested.txt
cd sub
exec sesam run --secret ./nested.txt -- runprobe env SESAM_SECRET_SUB_NESTED_TXT
stdout 'SESAM_SECRET_SUB_NESTED_TXT="raw-value\\n" exists=true'
! exists nested.txt

-- raw-fixture --
raw-value
-- env-fixture --
# strict dotenv fixture
export TOKEN = 'dotenv value'
EMPTY=
LITERAL=$(touch_owned)
